title: Amazon’s Bee wearables use AI to note down important pointers from your gossip
description: While Google was busy bringing its Fitbit Edge to the global market, and Fitbit Air to India, Amazon went for something far more ambitious. Amazon has unveiled two new hardware devices designed to capture, summarise, and act upon the spoken world around you. Meet the Bee Frontier and the Bee Eclipse. Although these are marketed as personal productivity companions, the new wearables in Amazon’s “Bee” ecosystem aim to solve a universal human frustration – forgotten details.
